claims.claim: Reviewers note that the game features AI-generated content and criticize its inclusion.

citations.review_text: It was fun for a while, the best part of this game was how slow you had to take your runs. It made every decision feel impactful. Unfortunately they have started using AI. The strength was always in its atmosphere and "spooky" vibes. Now that that is all generated by some robot, I can't recommend it. There are plenty of other options that can fill a dark and darker shaped hole

I was really starting to get into this, like, given the pattern of how I feel with some games, this had grabbed hold of my attention and I was going to get so much mileage in it. 

Now to preface I bounced off this hard before, but it was my first spin with an extraction type game and I hadn't fully embraced that 'losing can be fun', but having come back after a several month break because a streamer I follow was doing more, I really enjoyed the PvE mode for letting me set my own pace and just get to grips with the basics. 

I was enjoying it so much that I was planning to buy the paid legendary edition! And then! Boom, 'AI-disclosure'. Apparently it's a fresh and recent addition too but I simply... don't trust anything will ever stop once it's opened the slop gate. "Oh it's just for concepts and assets or things that will never see the game." is just the first step to get people to trust and agree to a slipper slope vague comment that can be broadened to mean anything. 

I would love to be able to recommend this, the difficulty, the existence of a lower stakes PvE, the setbacks of dying, the learning curve all appeal to me. It's just sad that a company whose motto on their home page Are that they were "disillusioned by the exploitative and greedy practices [they] once helped create" and object to companies that "sell their soul for the easy payday".   Well... AI. The stark contradiction.

I can no longer play the game I paid for, thanks to their recent changes with requiring Secure Boot and TPM 2.0.  

They have also decided to start using AI generated content, which is hilarious considering they fought so hard against the allegations of stealing content for their game, just to go to using gen AI which steals from creators.

Locking comments because y'all can't behave, but to address some common 'questions'... I played on two different accounts, my streaming account was not linked to steam.  I didn't play much on steam because I had better stuff on my other account (IE: Premium skins I liked). 

Yes, despite what you say, secure boot *is* a requirement, it literally flashes on the steam page if you don't have it that it is now a requirement (for some parts of the game). 

The people skimming reviews for things to hurl insults over are a good indicator of why I stopped playing this game to begin with. Both the developer and the community suck.

claims.claim: Reviewers mention that movement and monster animations feel stiff and clunky.

citations.review_text:
There’s no beginner level. The movements are stiff and clunky. Most of the time, you’ll run into a wizard or some other spellcaster and get killed by an area-of-effect attack. There’s no balance in this game, the meta is broken, and there’s no flexibility to play the way you want. At first, you have to play according to the meta. You’ll feel slow; some paid races that are faster will always outpace you, and you won’t even be able to catch up to them. 

The PVE mode is great. Visually, it’s perfect as a dungeon crawler; the monsters move a bit clunkily, but they’re very well-designed, which perfectly captures the dungeon atmosphere. 

Make this game less clunky, make it fair for every class, make sure it isn’t a “pay-to-win” game, and make it less difficult, otherwise, you’ll be stuck with an average of 9,000 players.
Fun game,  Quick matches.  I am PVE only though.  There is a bit of clunk, over all an enjoyable experience.

citations.review_text:
Really good game, worth a try
It is a bit hard to start because it lacks a nice tutorial so you should learn through youtube tutorial probably but once you know how the game works, it gets really good and fun

You can start with the free version and upgrade to the Legendary to get new game modes :
High rollers for higher stakes games with better stuff, mobs and loot
Squire royal for a nice and fun battle royal mode with a lot of quick pvp
Arena to have some 3v3 with your friends

Dark and Darker is a fun game.*

Dark and Darker is a very fun game which has overcome a lot of challenges to even remain as a game. The developers update the game on a VERY regular basis with minor balances and changes. A lot of those balances are very misguided.

There will always be an extremely overpowered build; and, thanks to the modern gaming landscape with streamers and content creators spreading the good word on how to 'dominate lobbies' there will always be a pain in the a** that you hate coming up against. On the flip side, they do correct their errors; while they may make new ones they obviously love their game and actively try to keep PvP balanced. 

The game could do with a tutorial. The game could do with the acquisition of wealth actually meaning something, hell, the game could do with a practice arena so new players could fight bosses without being terrified. The game could do with a lot of things, but what it does, it does really well; you just have to be willing to suffer to enjoy it.

Sidenote: Battlepasses suck, nobody is going to enjoy playing the free version of the game and miniature runes on the side of your health pot are not worth more than £10, especially when you copy & paste those across every item in the game.  Ironmace should get learn that they have are lucky to have the fan base they do and respect them.

claims.claim: Reviewers mention that the game features periodic seasonal character and economy wipes.

citations.review_text: Game is good, but seasonal resets are stupid, learn from Arc Raiders and other extraction games how to manage economy without wipes

Fantasy exfil fps, decent learning curve to the game.

Pros: Classes/team comps are fun. Diverse loot/abilities/perks adds a lot of variety. Consistent rollout of map designs & mobs. Fun PvP. Marketplace for buying/selling/trading items with other players. Loyal player base.

Cons: Poor balancing of classes. Developer indecisiveness when rolling out changes. Lots of ratting. Combat is very door-centric.

Overall worth a play. If you do get into the game, the growing pains will become obvious. Game wipes every few months.

A fantastic dungeon crawling extraction looter with a lot of care for the players. The shop in my opinion is pricy but also unnecessary to game play. Featuring several different classes that feel unique. You will have to deal with progress/stash wipes to keep the game from being overdominated but, leveling is quick and loot is accessible.
Important note: This game was never intended to be free to play and is not. You get a lot of access for free. However Ironmace made it free with a DLC upgrade to make good on a promise that early access players would be able to transfer their account from their launcher to Steam when it was published on steam.
